numeric_policy: Unknown/unverified numeric USD values are null in JSON and empty in CSV. Published components are text, not executable quotes.

rows.method_name: Bank telegraphic transfer — documented China salary
rows.feasibility_note: Conditional on lawful source, bank/operator approval and documents for USD 10,000; no fixed legal cap assumed.
rows.published_components: BOC current tariff effective 2025-11-11: cross-border TT commission 0.1% of remittance amount, minimum CNY 50, maximum CNY 260 per transaction; TT cable CNY 150 outside HK/Macao/TW or CNY 80 to those regions; overseas bank charges actual. Conditional USD full-arrival service: USD 15 if receiving bank has a BOC New York account, otherwise USD 25, only for eligible indirect routing. Fee currency conversion uses BOC's transaction-time buying rate if collected in FX.
rows.formula: commission_CNY = min(max(0.001 * gross_remittance_CNY_equivalent, 50), 260); cable_CNY = 150 (international) or 80 (HK/Macao/TW); all_in_USD = FX_friction + fees_USD + routing_USD + tax_USD + preparation_USD
rows.source_title: Bank of China — Personal customer services: personal finance, effective 2025-11-11

rows.formula: all_in_USD = live Wise fee + FX/routing difference + tax_USD + preparation_USD; obtain executable quote

rows.feasibility_note: Large target generally unsuitable: CNY 100,000/person/year and CNY 10,000/card/day caps apply.
rows.published_components: SAFE cap: CNY 100,000 equivalent/person/calendar year across all domestic cards; CNY 10,000/card/day.
